title: fr.csi.stream_start arguments
description: Starts streaming records to the hub over HTTP (design csi-c1 D11). Dispatch never blocks: OK once the fr_stream task has the stream, BUSY while another runs, INVALID_ARGS for source peer without a 6-byte peer_mac (here or in config). A connection that cannot be opened ends the stream with stream_ended net_lost (records 0).

stream_id.description: issued by the hub; the POST path names it

source.description: absent: config source; for this stream only

peer_mac.description: absent: config peer_mac; for this stream only (<= 6 bytes)
